linkedin.text:
🚨 You're rebuilding OAuth flows for every SaaS tool your agent touches.

The usual approach? Copy-paste credential handling into every integration, debug token refresh failures at 2 AM, and pray your agent doesn't leak API keys into logs.

🛠️ OpenConnector is the open-source auth gateway that solves this:

✅ Authenticate Gmail, Slack, GitHub, or 1,000+ providers once
✅ Agents call 10,000+ prebuilt actions without seeing credentials
✅ Self-host on Docker, Cloudflare Workers, or use OOMOL's managed runtime

⭐ 4,250 stars prove developers are done rebuilding auth.

🚀 Search "oomol-lab open-connector" on GitHub and try the Docker quickstart.

Which SaaS provider do you wish your agent could safely access?
